loading.no_gap_rule: after success #loadWrap is hidden/display:none and margin/padding/height are zero

action_regression_guard.rule: #action .mr-body must contain actual notice and phase cards, never a bordered empty panel
action_regression_guard.fold_rule: collapse -> body height 0; expand -> body returns to real content height

fold_contract: delegated document click handler owns all fold buttons
collapsed body uses display:none and zero height
normal flow only; no transform/translate gap repair
performance: compounder and QQQ TradingView charts lazy-load near viewport
optional data failure must not delete core UI
android_back_contract: modal open -> hardware Back closes modal
hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION.
apk_done_definition: Browser QA success -> Android Actions success -> Artifact exists -> APK downloaded and integrity checked -> provide file directly to user
